The '''Tosh Residence''' was a tent that housed the young miner [[Jann Tosh]] and his gruff uncle [[Putch Gundarian|Gundy]]. Near the home was a cave that allowed Gundy and Jann to search for Keshels, the currency of the planet of [[Tyne's Horky]]. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], Tosh allowed his droids, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to stay after he purchased them from [[Yorpo Mog]], and later housed [[Mon Julpa]] back to health at the residence. After a cave-in occurred in the cave, Gundy was injured but relished at the fact that the cave in caused Keshels to be uncovered, making the family rich, as Gundy stated.
